snippet.title: An Altered State Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
For the past year and a half, I’ve been working on a horror visual novel called An Altered State. It actually began as a short film I created back in college—and now it’s grown into a full game.

I just launched the Steam page, and you can find the link below. If you could take a moment to wishlist it, that would mean the world to me—it really helps with visibility and support.

I also want to mention that I created everything myself—the art, the music, and the writing. An Altered State is a passion project through and through.

The game is set to release in Q1 of next year. Stay tuned, and thanks so much for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3909450/An_Altered_State/
